findings.title: Cross-Service Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) — A reaches internal service B — imageUrl
findings.description: Technique: WSTG-INPV-19 (SSRF) — cross-service reach confirmed out-of-band (P6) at a collaborator co-located with B. Parameter: imageUrl.
evidence: Request: Cross-service SSRF http://localhost:3000/profile/image/url — imageUrl=http://host.docker.internal:18082/spgizgdz4k3s7k6nmbruh6kqne (targeting in-scope internal service B http://host.docker.internal:18082/)

confirmation=P6 out-of-band callback recorded AT B (collaborator co-located with B) — proves A REACHES B, not merely that A egresses somewhere
